classifiedDifferences.name: Improved Brutal Strike (2)
classifiedDifferences.reason: Foundry suffixes the level-17 improvement with “(2)”; Oracle preserves the SRD/5etools name and distinguishes it by canonical level ID.

classifiedDifferences.name: Unarmed Strike
classifiedDifferences.reason: Foundry embeds the shared Unarmed Strike item in the Barbarian class folder. Oracle already stores Unarmed Strike in the item/rules layer, so it is not duplicated as a class feature.
Foundry stores some choices and improvements as Advancement documents; Oracle keeps reusable feature entities plus explicit AdvancementStep/scaleValues.
